additions.summary: [VS-E04-S01-ST01] Implement site building and exact-unit master
additions.actor: Authorized backoffice operator or trusted ViStay service
additions.outcome: Property Service exposes create/update/read/search for mandatory site, optional building, and exact unit master data with optimistic concurrency and immutable identity.

inScope: Add site/building/exact-unit GraphQL commands and cursor queries.

interfaces: Expose only the operations named in this issue through the owning GraphQL or gRPC boundary.
Return stable validation, forbidden, not-found, conflict, and dependency-unavailable codes.

dataOwnership: Property owns sites, buildings, exact units, amenities, property-party references, supply terms, and booking-eligibility projection; Booking owns commercial price snapshots.
stateMachine: Unit lifecycle is ONBOARDING -> ACTIVE -> MAINTENANCE/SUSPENDED -> OFFBOARDING -> INACTIVE.

fieldGroups: SUMMARY is baseline; DOCUMENT and INTERNAL_AUDIT require explicit field-group grants.

failureSemantics: Reject malformed or unauthorized calls before mutating state and do not reveal whether a restricted aggregate exists.
Map stale expectedVersion to CONFLICT_STALE_REVISION and unavailable required dependencies to DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.
Retry only object-store, scanner, or event-publication failures classified as transient; retain the failed job for bounded repair.
idempotencyConcurrency: Require an idempotency key for commands that can be retried externally and persist its request fingerprint and result.
Use aggregate version compare-and-swap so concurrent writers produce one winner and a stable conflict for losers.
Deduplicate consumed events by event ID and business key.
